intro.text: A place on Roshar with a merchant who sold fine drawing supplies.
A city in northeastern Jah Keved, on a bay off the eastern Reshi Sea close to Herdaz, and northern Jah Keved's largest city.

items.text: Helaran Davar ordered expensive drawing supplies for his sister Shallan from a Northgrip merchant, and they were delivered to the Davar estate.
After reaching the Shattered Plains, Shallan sent a letter to her family by way of Northgrip, hoping that its distance from the fighting of the Veden civil war would help the letter get through.
